briefs: APEC opens in Shenzhen — Xi gives keynote
Fed minutes due after Wall St slide
DR Congo: Ebola adds 400–500 a week
Japan scrambles jets — two Russian planes
NSA network down — no hack seen
Apple outage hits iCloud and Pay
Voyager 1 — first craft one light-day out
Estonia to shut Russia border post
Gaza cold — UN: deaths from cold
Daegu mayor acquitted over martial law
power tax cut, fuel prices capped

featured.deck: US jets hit a missile site on Qeshm after drones targeted a US radar in Bahrain.
featured.headline: US and Iran trade fire over Bahrain and Qeshm

featured.deck: Kyiv says a second day of strikes destroyed the road arch. Moscow says it downed 1,441 drones.
featured.headline: A span of the Crimea bridge falls into the sea

featured.deck: Talks and a working lunch in Manila, a day after the first Quad summit in two years.
featured.headline: Trump meets Marcos, then flies to Shenzhen

featured.deck: First results since Huang resigned; data-centre sales rose 110%. It forecasts $130bn next quarter.
featured.headline: Nvidia's revenue doubles to $115.8bn

featured.deck: Landfall due 20 November, gusts to 145 km/h. Odisha is moving 200,000 people from the coast.
featured.headline: Cyclone Akvan bears down on India's east coast

featured.deck: Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, replaces Amir Ohana after a seven-hour debate.
featured.headline: Knesset elects Kahana as speaker, 66–52

featured.deck: The loan would cover about two-thirds of Kyiv's 2027 gap, repaid only if Russia pays reparations.
featured.headline: EU proposes a €45bn loan for Ukraine

featured.deck: Eight Israeli firms and the group Tzav 9 face asset freezes over West Bank settlements.
featured.headline: Britain sanctions settlement builders

featured.deck: C$400m relief on pork and seafood; steel relief extended. Beijing and Ottawa extend cooperation.
featured.headline: China cuts tariffs as Xi meets Carney

featured.deck: AP calls it: 144,302 votes to Sullivan's 131,844. A ninth Democratic gain, the most since 1958.
featured.headline: Democrat Peltola wins Alaska; Senate now 56-44

featured.deck: October CPI up from 3.5% as diesel hits a record high, the ONS says.
featured.headline: UK inflation rises to 3.6%, highest in a year

featured.deck: First report to the Security Council, obtained by AP, says Israel blocked the civil administration.
featured.headline: Board of Peace warns UN the Gaza truce may collapse

featured.deck: Electricity 35% of energy use by 2035, Anadolu reports. Rockström warns of 2.8–3°C.
featured.headline: COP31: 75 countries back Türkiye's “35x35” goal

footer: Every story was reported on Wednesday 18 November 2026; disputed claims are attributed. Sources: Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, Al Jazeera and others. Original drawings.
subline: Strikes in the Gulf and on the Kerch bridge, a first Quad summit in Manila, Nvidia's revenue doubling — and Alaska turning the Senate 56–44.
